summary: IHS Holding Ltd filed its Form 6-K for Q1 2026, reporting the disposal of its Latin America segment (iSystems Soluções de Infraestrutura S.A.) as a discontinued operation. The filing discloses the sale completed around May 11, 2026, with consideration including vendor loan notes (USD and RWF). No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as its quarterly report. The divestiture streamlines IHS to focus on Africa—watch for regulatory approvals and use of proceeds for debt reduction.
